changelog: Chat Editorial Typography & Contextual Rendering: Theme-adaptive inline code pills, +N/-N diff pills, exit code pills, Markdown-formatted Thinking accordion, coalesced paragraphs, adaptive Dark/Light syntax highlighting with diff/patch coloring, soft-wrap toggle, Fixed Code/App Preview tabs, and colored tool output & severity logs

Universal Design System Across Every Screen: Extended GraventUiTokens & GraventKit primitives (GraventBadge, GraventEmptyState, GraventLogConsole, unified file accents) across Settings, Installer, Permissions, Diagnostics, File Manager, Branched Tree, IDE, Browser, Claude, and Copilot UI with zero Light Mode contrast regressions

Backend Speed & Streaming Engine Overhaul: Eliminated O(N^2) streaming rebuilds via TrajectoryEngine turn snapshot/message caching & deterministic timestamps, fixed UI flush stalling & backgrounded media/IO work in AgyChatBackend, added Copilot SSE throttling + stream closing, added distinctUntilChanged & async SharedPreferences writes, and isolated floating overlay state from root recomposition
